host.description: The host that originated the Splunk event.  This data is present on all Splunk events, but may not be available in searches that use grouping (stats, timechart, etc.).  Grouped searches may include host, but often do not.

cloudIdentity.description: The structured data (pod, function, etc.) that is available when host is supplied.  This field is populated when host data is present in results.

t_tenant.description:
environment information

The tenant of the action
Search sample:  "search a_t a_st!="Complete" | stats count as a_count by t_tenant, t_tag, a_st | sort - a_count"

t_tag.description:
The tag of the action
Search sample:  "search a_t a_st!="Complete" | stats count as a_count by t_tenant, t_tag, a_st | sort - a_count"

t_module.description:
action information

The module of the action
Search sample:  "search a_t | stats count as a_count by t_module, t_type, t_action | search a_count>1000 | sort - a_count"

t_type.description:
The type invoking the action
Search sample:  "search a_t | stats count as a_count by host, t_type, t_action | search a_count>1000 | sort - a_count"

t_action.description:
The action function
Search sample:  "search a_t | stats count as a_count by host, t_type, t_action | search a_count>1000 | sort - a_count"

a_st.description:
The exit status of the action
Search sample:  "search a_t a_st!="Complete" | stats count as a_count by host, t_type, t_action, a_st | sort - a_count"

a_pfuncs.description:
The function pointers of the action.  Analogous to a compact, masked call-stack.
Search sample:  "search a_t | stats avg(a_t) as a_t_avg by host, t_type, t_action, a_pfuncs | search a_t_avg>100 | sort - a_t_avg"

a_count.description:
stats

The count of action event logs
Search sample:  "search a_t | stats count as a_count by host, t_type, t_action | search a_count>1000 | sort - a_count"

a_t.description:
The time the action took to execute
Search sample:  "search a_t>100 | table t_type, t_action, a_t | sort - a_t"

a_t_avg.description:
The average of a_t of actions
Search sample:  "search a_t | stats avg(a_t) as a_t_avg by t_type, t_action | search a_t_avg>60 | sort - a_t_avg"

a_t_p95.description:
The 95th percentile of a_t of actions
Search sample:  "search a_t | stats p95(a_t) as a_t_p95 by t_type, t_action | sort - a_t_p95"

a_t_p99.description:
The 99th percentile of a_t of actions
Search sample:  "search a_t | stats p99(a_t) as a_t_p99 by t_type, t_action | sort - a_t_p99"

a_t_min.description:
The minimum a_t of actions
Search sample:  "search a_t | stats min(a_t) as a_t_min, count as a_count by host, t_type, t_action | search a_count>100 a_t_min<0.01 | sort + a_t_min"

a_t_max.description:
The maximum a_t of actions
Search sample:  "search a_t>600 | stats max(a_t) as a_t_max by t_type, t_action | sort - a_t_max"

a_t_stdev.description:
The stdev a_t of actions
Search sample:  "search a_t | stats stdev(a_t) as a_t_stdev by t_type, t_action | sort - a_t_stdev"

a_t_max_div_avg.description:
maximum( a_t ) / average( a_t ).  Meant to identify actions that have highly variant execution patterns
Splunk search sample:  "search a_t | stats avg(a_t) as a_t_avg, max(a_t) as a_t_max by t_type, t_action, a_pfuncs | eval a_t_max_div_avg=(a_t_max/a_t_avg) | search (a_t_max>30 OR a_t_max_div_avg>100) | sort - a_t_max_div_avg"

title:
Data available in Splunk searches that group "action" log events. Specifically, Search (most likely) starts with "search a_t ...".
Note that any particular result row is expected to be populated with only subset of fields, based on the fields in search.
name: SplunkSearchResultActionRow
